name: coffee_shop_count
description: One row per photo of the coffee shop: how busy it is, how long the line is, and how many seats are free. Any field the model cannot see must be "unknown", never a guess.

fields.name: clock_time
fields.description: the time on a clock or screen in the photo, as HH:MM

fields.name: n_people
fields.description: total number of people in the photo, staff included

fields.name: n_in_queue
fields.description: number of people standing in line to order

fields.name: seats_free
fields.description: number of seats with nobody and nothing on them

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: how sure you are about the counts

fields.name: notes
fields.description: one short sentence on anything that made the photo hard to read
